title: Mary Gay Scanlon addresses tariffs and congressional transparency on social media - South Delco News
text:
Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon, who has represented Pennsylvania’s 5th district in the U.S. Congress since 2018, recently posted a series of statements on her official Twitter account addressing tariffs, congressional oversight, and holiday greetings.
On December 12, 2025, Scanlon responded to ongoing policy debates by stating: “Wrong on all accounts. Reverse all the blanket tariffs.”
Later that day, she commented on efforts by House Judiciary Democrats to obtain access to special counsel Jack Smith’s report before his upcoming deposition. In her tweet from December 12, 2025, Scanlon wrote: “I joined @RepRaskin and @HouseJudiciary democrats in demanding access to special counsel Jack Smith’s report before his deposition next week. @JudiciaryGOP has already blocked the public from seeing Smith’s testimony. They shouldn’t be allowed to cover up the report too.”
On December 14, 2025, Scanlon extended holiday wishes to her constituents with a message reading: “I want to wish a happy Hanukkah to everyone in PA-05 gathering with their loved ones to celebrate the festival of lights!”
Scanlon succeeded Pat Meehan as representative for Pennsylvania’s 5th district in 2018 and currently resides in Swarthmore. Born in Watertown, New York in 1959, she is now 63 years old. She holds a BA from Colgate University (1980) and earned her JD from the University of Pennsylvania in 1984.
